name: Jimmy Fallon
bio: James Thomas Fallon, Jr. (born September 18, 1974) is an American actor, television host, comedian, singer, and musician. He currently hosts NBC's Late Night with Jimmy Fallon, a late-night talk show. Prior to that, he was best known as a cast member on Saturday Night Live from 1998–2004, as well as appearing in several films.
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, USA
